name: ignite-medical/ci-cache-and-security
description: Managed bundled WordPress plugins for ci-cache-and-security (replaces the hard-copied plugins/query-monitor/ tree).

imt-dependency-notes._status: Managed via WordPress Packagist; installs to the existing plugins/query-monitor/ path. DROP-IN bump, but see recommendation.
imt-dependency-notes.wpackagist-plugin/query-monitor: Replaces hard-copied plugins/query-monitor/ (was 3.3.7) with managed 3.17.x at the same path. RECOMMENDATION: Query Monitor is a DEVELOPER DEBUG plugin — shipping it inside a production security plugin is itself a risk (review notes a 1,668-line wp-login.php fork lives here too). Strongly prefer REMOVING it rather than bundling. `composer install` will materialize the managed copy if you keep it.
